component.name: Horizon
component.summary: Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 rewritten in Rust

description.p: Horizon is an unofficial Minecraft: Java Edition client and launcher written in Rust. It requires your own legally obtained copy of Minecraft.
The Flatpak sandboxes the launcher and grants read-only access to the standard Minecraft data directory. Horizon worlds and settings are stored in the application's Flatpak data directory.
